rationale: All devices went offline simultaneously at ~7am with the base station showing solid red LED and E-503 (no internet uplink), pointing to a system-level uplink fault rather than individual device issues. The trigger was the router replacement the previous day: the Ethernet cable was in the WAN port, and after moving it to a LAN port and restarting the router, the base station LED turned solid blue and all cameras/sensors came back online. This matches historical case H-04 and confirms an L1 network-down cause, now resolved.

repair_steps: Confirm the base station Ethernet cable is plugged into a LAN port on the new router, not the WAN/Internet port.
Restart the router (unplug power, wait 30 seconds, plug back in, wait for full boot).
Restart the base station (unplug power, wait 10 seconds, plug back in).
Verify the base station LED turns solid blue and all devices come back online.
If still solid red, check router admin page for base station connectivity and set DNS to automatic.
If issue persists after these steps, escalate to FAE.
